label: Playwright Browser Setup
description: How to use Playwright/Chromium for browser automation and the live browser panel.

aspects.name: setup
attributes: Playwright + Chromium are pre-installed. npm install will FAIL (outbound blocked). Use symlink instead.

aspects.name: usage
attributes: Built-in browser tool works after symlink: browser action="launch" url="..." — streams live to control panel
Use wait_until="domcontentloaded" — networkidle often times out
